requirement: Remove cookie-consent interruptions from games embedded in Puzzle Date.

architecture.decision: Extend the existing Puzzle Date child-frame cleanup with a bounded main-world consent handler that chooses reject/decline/necessary-only actions inside known consent containers, then cosmetically hides remaining known CMP overlays.
seams: Run only in child frames of tabs already enabled by the trusted Puzzle Date content script.
Never click accept/allow/agree actions and never write or clear cookies or browser storage directly.
Use exact privacy-preserving action text and known consent-container selectors to avoid clicking unrelated game controls.

tasks.title: Implement privacy-preserving consent cleanup
tasks.intent: Reject, dismiss, or hide cookie-consent UI inside Puzzle Date game frames without accepting tracking.
tasks.constraints: Scope to ad-block-enabled Puzzle Date child frames; match only known consent containers and exact reject/necessary-only labels; never accept consent or manipulate cookies/storage.
tasks.acceptance: Known consent dialogs automatically choose a reject/decline/necessary-only control when present; otherwise known overlays are hidden; late-rendered dialogs are handled for a bounded interval; unrelated game controls remain untouched.
tasks.verify: npm run validate:extension && node --check chrome-extension/background.js && git diff --check
tasks.result: Added bounded known-container consent cleanup that selects only exact reject/decline/necessary-only actions, uses container-scoped close fallback and cosmetic hiding, and never directly manipulates cookies or storage.

tasks.title: Package and publish consent cleanup
tasks.intent: Release the consent cleanup as extension 1.0.8 with accurate in-app and installation copy.
tasks.constraints: Describe reject/dismiss behavior accurately; do not claim universal support; retain ad-block and reset documentation; sync only verified files.
tasks.acceptance: Version 1.0.8 is packaged, Chrome-tested, published, and the live in-app download serves the exact tested ZIP.
tasks.verify: npm run validate:extension && npm run package:extension && npm run build:pages && unzip -t public/downloads/puzzle-date-game-reset.zip
tasks.visual: Reload 1.0.8 and verify representative embedded games remain usable and known consent overlays do not obstruct them.
tasks.result: Released extension 1.0.8 after a controlled Chrome test proved a recognized dialog containing both Accept All and Reject All selected Reject All, plus Waffle load and Verticle Start Over regressions passed; packaged the exact four-file ZIP and updated all user-facing download copy.
